quiz.question: What does a VLAN do?
options: Splits one switch into separate broadcast domains
quiz.answer_text: Splits one switch into separate broadcast domains
quiz.why: VLANs separate traffic on the same switches into logical networks, for example keeping guest Wi-Fi away from staff devices. Moving between VLANs needs a router or Layer 3 switch.
